annotations.text:
Platform page redesign — dark theme

References: openai.com + neon.com
Type: Geist (display) · Inter (body) · Geist Mono (labels) — the Neon stack, with Geist standing in for Neon's licensed ES Build Neutral.
Accent: Mialo blue #6C93FF primary, Neon green #00E599 used sparingly (live dots, eyebrow ticks, pulses).

Same content as the current page, fully re-structured: left-aligned section headers, hairline dividers, near-black bento cards, monospace eyebrows, generous vertical rhythm.

See design.md for the full system to reuse on other pages.
